name: crew
description: Run several Claude Code sessions on one working tree and one branch without lost edits: a coordinator/worker playbook, identity by display name (auto-join from the session title), unique across crews on one machine, a one-screen status of every dirty path by owner, crew-tagged hand-off messages with a durable mailbox (inbox, unread notices, a Stop check), hot-spot holds, a slot queue for machine time (cpu / exclusive / quiet), copies landed with a merge-or-refuse apply, a snapshot before every edit, exact-path-list commits under one committer, and guard hooks that deny whole-index git commands. Layered project/user config; costs nothing in repos without a crew. Runtime-free (bash + awk + git).
